 Manager
By Standing Counsel (B/O) For R3

This Motor accidents claims appeal having come up for orders on 10.01.2025, the Court on the same day passed the following:
 P.T.O  C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, J  -----------------------------------------------
 C.M.Appl. No.1 of 2025  in  MACA.No.22 of 2025  ------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 10th day of January, 2025
ORDER This is an application filed by the appellants praying for condoning the delay of 371 days in filing the appeal.
2. The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning the delay.

Sreejith.T.V vs Prakasan.N on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160752236/
1 3.
The petitioner filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal related to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 371 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
4. In the result, this application is allowed on condition that the petitioners will not be eligible for interest for the enhanced amount of compensation, if any, in appeal.
MACA Appeal is admitted.
The learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the 3 rd respondent.
Policy is admitted, hence notice to respondents 1 and 2 is dispensed with.
Post for hearing.

Sd/-
 C. PRATHEEP KUMAR,
 JUDGE 10-01-2025
SMA /True
Copy/ Assista Sreejith.
